description: This PHP source file defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing reporting method configurations within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, validation rules, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationAPI
classes.description: This class provides API endpoints for managing reporting method configurations, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting reporting methods, with integrated validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ReportingMethod by ID, throws RecordNotFoundException if not found, returns a resource result with the model.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all reporting methods with support for sorting and pagination, returning a collection result with total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new reporting method using provided parameters, returns the created resource.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Saves or updates a ReportingMethod entity, fetching existing by ID if available, sets name, and persists via the service.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a reporting method by ID, delegating to saveReportingMethod, and returns the resource result.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes reporting methods by IDs provided in request body, returns a result with the list of deleted IDs.
